summary: Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) to register senior callable fixed-to-floating rate notes and senior callable floating rate notes. The aggregate principal amount, coupon rates, and maturity date are to be determined; notes are redeemable one year before maturity or for tax reasons. The notes will be listed on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange's Euro MTF Market, are unsecured and in minimum denominations of $200,000. This is a plain-vanilla debt offering, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, restructuring or other corporate-event categories apply.
